candidates.description: Always available. Produces zero config updates; a full success, not a fallback.
Always selectable abstention. No success/failure score is attached to choosing it.
Rejected 2026-09-26 (see rejected_reason). Kept in the catalog as a record and so that tests can exercise the candidate logic; never offered to the provider.
candidates.provider_description: Enable adaptive per-frame quality weighting (global_metrics.adaptive_weights = true). Its benefit is unproven; measured evidence is listed in candidate_facts.
candidates.rejected_reason: Six paired sessions (M31, M42, IC5070, M66, IC4605, M104) show no sharpness gain on matched stars (FWHM ratio 0.999-1.005 against a required <= 0.95), 2-3 % more noise on half of them, and the flag can change the registration reference frame and with it the stack geometry. Reopen only with evidence from a different setup.

candidates.description: Table-driven: the header camera string, after normalisation (upper case, letters and digits only), must be one of camera_aliases. Both spellings were observed in real DWARF II data ('DWARFII' in M31, 'DWARF II' in M42/IC5070/M66). The pipeline's sensor profile enum names this profile explicitly; every DWARF II example and production config already sets it, so on those configs the candidate is a no-op (already_active). Whether it improves the stretch is unproven; the value only changes when the draft still carries another profile. The provider never sees the camera name; applicability is decided by the backend.
candidates.provider_description: Set the stretch sensor profile to the DWARF II profile. Offered only when the backend matched the frame-header camera to a DWARF II; candidate_facts.camera_match confirms it.

value_grid.basis: only the level confirmed by release_policy_v2 (set_pixfrac, 0.8 -> 1.0); 0.6 fails the coverage gate and is not offered

candidates.description: Pixel fraction 0.8 -> 1.0. Confirmed on five sessions (M31, M104, M66, M42, IC5070; 120-frame subsets): matched background noise x0.91, n_eff +46 %, star FWHM/elongation unchanged. Offered only from the control level 0.8, the only level the evidence was measured against. Not a release: see docs/PI/pi_jev_bestaetigung_pixfrac_clip_20260926_de.md.
candidates.provider_description: Raise the drizzle pixel fraction from 0.8 to 1.0. Measured on five sessions at equal star sharpness: about 9 % less background noise and more effective coverage. Offered only when the draft currently uses 0.8.

candidates.description: Clipping sigma 4/4 -> 5/5 (atomic pair). Confirmed on five sessions: matched background noise x0.94-0.97, star sharpness unchanged. Offered only from 4/4, the control level of the evidence; configs at 2/4 (M42, IC5070, M66 production profile) are not offered it because that contrast was not pre-registered. Not a release: see docs/PI/pi_jev_bestaetigung_pixfrac_clip_20260926_de.md.
candidates.provider_description: Widen both clipping thresholds from 4 to 5 sigma. Measured on five sessions at equal star sharpness: about 3-6 % less background noise. Offered only when the draft currently uses 4/4.
